description: This Java class 'AutoCompleteRequest' models a request object for generating autocomplete queries in JSON format. It includes methods to construct JSON strings for search queries based on merchant and language codes, and to generate collection names for search indexing.

classes.name: AutoCompleteRequest
classes.description: A class representing an autocomplete request, capable of generating JSON search queries and collection names based on merchant and language codes.

methods.name: AutoCompleteRequest
methods.description: Constructor to initialize merchant and language codes.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for the autocomplete query based on the input query.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Constructs a collection name string for search indexing based on keyword, language, and merchant codes.
